**Coaching Note:**

White's rook on d1 is undefended—your rook on e1 attacks it. Take it with Rxd1! After White recaptures with Rxd1, play Re1+ to drive the king away, then capture the rook again with Rxd1. You win a whole rook with a clean exchange. Look for undefended pieces your opponent just moved into the line of fire—they often can't afford to protect everything.
